title: Precomposition form of section projection coherence
statement: The canonical section/projection composite equals the canonical pushforward comparison before postcomposition by its inverse.

proof.text: For two oplax monoidal adjunctions, expand their symmetry-ordered left projection maps. The middle two braidings cancel by symmetry, and rightAdjointProjectionMap_comp identifies the result with the projection map of the composite adjunction. This is proved as the private lemma leftProjection_comp.

For an adjunction F ⊣ G, a natural isomorphism s:F≅Id whose component at the tensor unit is the oplax unit, and U≅1, transpose the proposed section/projection composite along the adjunction. The conjugateEquiv_counit equation replaces the transpose of the conjugate of s by s. Naturality of the comparison and the braiding moves the coefficient isomorphism next to its inverse. Naturality of s identifies their composite with the oplax unit, and oplax left unitality cancels the unitor and its inverse. Thus the composite equals the conjugate of s at M. This is the private lemma leftProjection_section, combined with the first step in leftProjection_section_comp.

Apply canonicalDerivedPullbackSectionUnit to pullSectionIso, with its canonical identification supplied by pullSectionIso_eq. The helper is proved in its own module from the published composition and identity unit equations and equality induction. Its explicit formula is definitionally the unit of the canonical strong monoidal composite pullback. Typed private aliases keep the canonical compositor and functors shared during kernel checking.

Identify traceProjection with the preceding symmetry-ordered mate using the fixed native derived tensor and its oplax comparison. Apply the two-adjunction calculation to the second projection and diagonal. Its conjugate is pushSectionIso by definition. Finally use pointwise ProjectionNormalized equalities and function extensionality to identify the entire projection family with traceProjection, unfold sectionTensorMap and the fixed tensor bundles, and specialize U and its unit isomorphism to the regular coefficient and singleUnitIso.

proof_origin.place: Second identity before cancellation; direct categorical proof using the published projection-mate composition and derived pullback unit-coherence equations.

lean.statement:
theorem canonical_section_projection_core_precomposition
    (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (M : DerivedCategory (Modules Λ (ProjectiveLine Y))) :
    ((ρ_ M).inv ≫
      (M ◁ ((singleUnitIso Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)).inv ≫
        (pushSectionIso Λ Y).hom.app (unit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)))) ≫
      projectionMap Λ (secondProjection Y) M
        ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ (diagonalImmersion Y)).obj
          (unit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y))) ≫
      (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ (secondProjection Y)).map
        (sectionTensorMap Λ (diagonalImmersion Y) (secondProjection Y)
          (pullSectionIso Λ Y (secondProjection Y)
            (by unfold secondProjection; exact pullback.diagonal_snd _))
          (unit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) (singleUnitIso Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) M)) =
      (pushSectionIso Λ Y).hom.app M
